t: Compact, low profile rechargeable headlamp with integrated LED. Constructed from durable ABS and aluminium. Features wide beam COB LED, focused spotlight beam and 5 light modes. Turbo mode offers short burts of 400lm when required, returning to previous mode after 35 seconds, high (250lm), low (50lm) and COB (100lm) mode. Adjustable strap. Integrated rechargeable battery allows for up to 8 hours of operation in between charges.
